This '''platoon''' was under the command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Hork]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The unit had a tradition where all new members had to grow beards or braids, and could only remove them when they were told to. Despite this, many of the members of the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] chose to keep their beards. The platoon was assigned to an [[Unidentified battle (Imperial strongpoint)|operation]] to take an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] strongpoint, which they managed to do with light casualties.
